Bus Stops, Stop Times, Routes, etc that change
about once a quarter

Data that changes about once a quarter and includes detailed route and schedule information - Bus
Stops, Stop Times, Routes, Agency, Calendar, Calendar Dates, Shapes, Trips, Fares

The files are comma delimited with field names in the first row; the format is dictated by Google at
https://developers.google.com/transit/gtfs/reference. Please consult that site for more details
on data definitions. Abbreviated descriptions are provided below.
The long name of the bus route

A number indicating whether the route is a bus
route, light rail, commuter train, etc. All ABQ
RIDE routes are bus routes, corresponding to
route_type 3.

The color the route text will be displayed in on the
map
The color the route will be displayed in on the map
The identification number of the bus route

The bus route number used to publicly identify the
route.

The identification number of the route shape to be
displayed on the map

The sequence the shapes should be displayed in on
the map

The sequence number of the bus stop on the route
for that trip.

stop_id of the parent station (e.g. the one point that
would be displayed if displaying all the individual
stops would create a cluttered map, like at a major
transfer center.)
The identification number of the bus route

The identification number of the shape to be
displayed on the map

The agency file contains all of the companies, government entities and other
establishments that have transit service described in the other files.

The routes file provides information about how the route should be displayed
on the map.

The shapes file provides the location where a specified route shape should be
displayed on the map.

The stop times file provides the details of when each trip that a bus takes on a
given route will be at each stop.

The trips file provides the information to connect the stop times, shapes, trips,
route and service together.
